cause_quote: The introducing diff added `params.onLifecycleCommitted?.();` after the awaited `runPreparedSqliteSessionWrite`, so a failure after SQLite committed could skip the notification.
user_saw: An operator could see a cleanup failure report that said the changes had not committed even though the session rows were already deleted.
summary: The fix records cleanup as committed when the outer SQLite transaction commits, before lifecycle publication and owner cleanup.
reasoning: PR #128905 introduced both the reported commit status and the callback that sets it. In that revision, lifecycle publication and a fallible deletion-owner check already ran after the database write but before the awaited writer returned, so the status could be wrong from its first release.
